summary: Your own Javelin model, running entirely on this machine via Ollama. A DERIVED model: it adopts Javelin's identity through the system prompt over a local 7B coder base. It is not a fine-tune — no weights were trained.

base.note: Builds from whichever local coder base is installed (qwen2.5-coder:7b by default). The base weights remain the base author's; what Javelin adds here is the identity.

methodNote: Ollama Modelfile (FROM + SYSTEM + PARAMETER). This is NOT training. It sets the system prompt and sampling defaults; it does not change the weights.

requirements.serveNote: A 7B model in Q4 fits comfortably in ~6GB VRAM (fits this machine's 10GB card), and runs on CPU too, slower.

local.detail: Fully local. `npm run model:local` builds it in Ollama on this machine; no key, no cloud, no data leaving the computer.

cloud.detail: Not a cloud model — it runs on your hardware by design.

status.note: Not a trained model. 'Served' is true once `npm run model:local` has created the model in Ollama and it answers. This manifest documents a derived local model, not a fine-tune.
